service: 24/7 CDRRMO Emergency Disaster Response & Rescue Hotline
description: Round-the-clock emergency medical response, vehicular accident extrication, flood/typhoon rescue, and disaster relief dispatch operated by the City Disaster Risk Reduction & Management Office (CDRRMO) Roxas City.
steps: Dial CDRRMO Roxas City 24/7 Operations Center: (036) 621-0500 or Mobile: 0977 204 9641 / 0927 509 1198.
Clearly state your name, exact location (Barangay, landmark, street), and nature of emergency.
Stay on the line while dispatch directs emergency ambulance or rescue units to the scene.
requirements: Emergency incident details and callback contact number

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Anyone requiring urgent assistance within Roxas City

sources.name: Roxas City Disaster Risk Reduction & Management Office

service: National Police Clearance & Roxas City PNP Assistance
description: Online application processing, biometric capture, and issuance of National Police Clearance at the Roxas City Police Station.
steps: Register and schedule an appointment online via https://pnpclearance.ph.
Pay the statutory police clearance fee through authorized Landbank/GCash payment channels.
Proceed to Roxas City Police Station (Corner Bilbao & Arzobispo St.) on scheduled date.
Undergo biometric capture (fingerprints, photo, digital signature) and claim printed clearance.

sources.name: Philippine National Police - Roxas City Police Station
